Cookouts Use clean, seasoned firewood or equivalent. Agricultural Waste Agricultural wastes and plant matter such as tree trimmings, stumps, brush, weeds, leaves, grass, shrubbery and material from crop or livestock production. This includes fence posts and scrap lumber, but not buildings. Fire must be more than 1,000 feet from neighbor's inhabited building. Must notify Ohio EPA in Advance. Land-Clearing Waste Not Permitted in City Limits. Residential Waste Not Permitted in City Limits. Ceremonial Fires Wood stack no larger than 5ft. high X 5ft. Wide.
